blurb: This check verifies that the named DNS server service is not running on the server. It checks whether named is set to start from the boot configuration file /etc/rc.tcpip or is already active as a system service. If named runs on a server that is not meant to be a DNS server, it leaves an unmanaged DNS service answering queries on the network, which attackers can abuse to reflect and amplify traffic or probe for a way in.
